card.name: The word between after relational nouns
card.fires_on: The word "between" (sometimes "with" or a hyphen) right after a noun for an agreement, conflict, interaction or relationship, where it introduces the two parties involved.

modes.label: Between after agreement or conflict
modes.description: "between" follows a noun like agreement, treaty, conflict or swaps and introduces two parties.

modes.label: Between after interaction or coefficient
modes.description: "between" follows interactions or a physical coefficient and introduces the two things related.
